sequencing: validate and freeze all 1024 D0 rows
CF only after L0, with placebo

generation_invariants: E0 remains the immutable deterministic control and is never relabeled as LLM output.
The owner authenticates locally through Sign in with ChatGPT; auth material is never committed or shared.
OPENAI_API_KEY and CODEX_API_KEY are removed from every child process.
Web search, apps, MCP, shell, memories, goals, hooks and multi-agent tools are disabled.
Every D0, L0 and CF work item uses codex exec --ephemeral and never resumes another thread.
D0 is generated without explanatory prose and becomes immutable before L0.
L0 cannot change D0 identities, probabilities, margin, participation posture or deterministic transition fields.
Every directional L0 statement must cite a row-local closed-catalogue evidence id.
Narrative confidence is not treated as causal evidence.
CF packets are deterministic synthetic diagnostics and are never confused with observed facts.
A placebo-sensitive agent cannot receive a supported causal label.
2016 and 2021 remain sealed throughout D0, L0 and CF generation.
frontend_invariants: The public site remains on E0 until G0 passes the complete terminal and promotion audit.
Before L0 data exist, the frontend displays method and pending status only; it invents no deliberations.
After promotion, model-generated explanations and counterfactual diagnostics are labelled separately.
E0 assets are archived and retained when G0 becomes primary.
G0 generation and fluent explanations do not by themselves establish predictive validity.
Social lambdas remain illustrative until the separate 2016 calibration and 2021 holdout.

change_control.before_first_valid_D0_output: amendments require a new freeze manifest version and explicit state update
change_control.after_first_valid_D0_output: model, reasoning effort, D0 prompt/schema, selection rules, evidence catalogue rules, CF transforms and causal thresholds are immutable for this run
change_control.after_any_outcome_unseal: no pre-outcome generation or diagnostic rule may be changed
